title.en: An Act Declaring May 28 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Malalag, Province of Davao Del Sur. to Be Known as "Araw Ng Malalag',In Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary
title.orig: An Act Declaring May 28 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Malalag, Province of Davao Del Sur. to Be Known as "Araw Ng Malalag',In Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 28 tháng 5 hằng năm là ngày làm việc lễ đặc biệt tại Đô thị Malalag, Tỉnh Davao Del Sur. với tên gọi "Araw Ng Malalag', nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 28 พฤษภาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันทำงานพิเศษในเทศบาล Malalag จังหวัด Davao Del Sur. ในชื่อ "Araw Ng Malalag' เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 28 Mei setiap tahun sebagai hari kerja khusus di Kotamadya Malalag, Provinsi Davao Del Sur. dengan nama "Araw Ng Malalag', dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 28 Mei setiap tahun sebagai hari bekerja khas di Perbandaran Malalag, Wilayah Davao Del Sur. dengan nama "Araw Ng Malalag', sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

text.en: May 28 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the Municipality of Malalag, Province of Davao del Sur, to be known as "Araw ng Malalag", in commemoration of its foundation anniversary. However, upon proclamation of the President, May 28 of every year shall be a special non-working holiday in the Municipality of Malalag, Province of Davao del Sur.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
